title: Moonshot AI Closes Final Private Round at $50B Valuation for 2027 IPO
summary:
The financial landscape for artificial intelligence startups in Asia is shifting as one of the largest firms prepares to engage with public shareholders. Moonshot AI has completed its final private funding round at a $50B valuation, which establishes a pricing benchmark as it prepares to list on a stock exchange.

The company targets the first quarter of 2027 for an initial public offering in Hong Kong. This conclusion of its private investment cycle marks the end of the venture-backed phase and moves the firm toward transparency and liquidity in the public markets.
